_comment: Hand-pasted demo clips, for creators whose per-exercise videos are unlisted and cannot be enumerated (Jeff Nippard's program link sheets). One object per clip: {"video_id": "11-char YouTube id", "key": "a catalog id from supabase/functions/spotter/catalog.ts", "title": "Front Squat", "secs": 12}. secs is optional. Entries without a video_id (like this one) are ignored, so this comment can stay. Rows from this file are trusted as written — method 'manual', tier 1 — and are never sent to the review file, so check the id and the key before pasting. Re-run: node tools/demo-videos.mjs run
